UNION ALL SELECT 'g2', main_cat, COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 GROUP BY main_cat

FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=f.ref_id
WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>500 AND i.prc_usd<=40

 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f JOIN items_g2 i ON i.ref_id=f.ref_id WHERE LENGTH(f.body)>=500 AND i.prc_usd<=40) n_ge500,
